# Locale `pl`

Unit names were seeded from CLDR 48.2.3.

## Plural rules

| Category | Condition |
|---|---|
| few | `v = 0 and i % 10 = 2..4 and i % 100 != 12..14` |
| many | `v = 0 and i != 1 and i % 10 = 0..1 or v = 0 and i % 10 = 5..9 or v = 0 and i % 100 = 12..14` |
| one | `i = 1 and v = 0` |
| other | *everything else* |

## Units

The identifier resolves in every locale and is what a conversion writes
when the locale has no symbol. Lookup is case-sensitive: `C` is Celsius
where `c` is a cup. Long forms are CLDR patterns by plural category,
with `{0}` where the number goes.

## Units chosen for the reader

locale 'pl' has no region, so there is no way to choose units for its readers: add the region the recipe is written for, as `sv-SE` does, or ask for a measurement system outright (`pl-u-ms-metric`, `pl-u-ms-ussystem`, `pl-u-ms-uksystem`).

Names come from the language alone; choosing units needs a region
(`pl-XX`) or a measurement system (`pl-u-ms-metric`, `ussystem`, `uksystem`).
